title: Certify the exact rational split optimum for fixed P104 flags
body:
**Exact finite optimum: rational split gathers reduce the junk count from 4,814 to 4,745 on the fixed eight flags of PR7748.** The full schedule improves 44 columns while preserving 104 diagonal entries equal to 2 and all 5,720 required odd off-diagonal zeros. Column 4 improves from the published split value 44 to its exact minimum 43. **No new kappa** follows.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/95bb52132797c0ed189f8558b74b048433922f74/research/p104-fixed-flag-split-optimum/PROOF.md), [104 column certificates and schedules](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/95bb52132797c0ed189f8558b74b048433922f74/research/p104-fixed-flag-split-optimum/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/95bb52132797c0ed189f8558b74b048433922f74/research/p104-fixed-flag-split-optimum/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/95bb52132797c0ed189f8558b74b048433922f74/research/p104-fixed-flag-split-optimum/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/95bb52132797c0ed189f8558b74b048433922f74/research/p104-fixed-flag-split-optimum/CREDITS.md). This resolves the fixed-flag optimum left open by [PR #7748](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7748). The flags, chain pairs and one-read rule are fixed; arbitrary rational legal gather pieces are allowed, with total one on each active chain.

The prefix coefficients describe all rational schedules, without a finite coefficient search. Exactly 4,715 junk entries are constant. Twenty-three integer contradiction certificates force 30 additional entries. All 1,400 equation subsets agree under direct rational elimination and the separate contradiction test. A matching full schedule proves the lower bound is sharp. Exhausting all 1,242 single-gather column schedules gives the comparison minimum 4,814.

The witness uses 490 nonzero pieces across 416 active column-chain pairs: 74 extra pieces. Its piece count is not claimed optimal, and physical movement and restoration are unpriced. The fixed flags remain worse than the 4,216-entry witness reported in [PR #7689](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7689); that global witness was not replayed here. This result is not a bound over all flags or a paid supplier improvement.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-fixed-flag-split-optimum
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_P104_FIXED_FLAG_SPLIT_OPTIMUM
104 columns: exact rational split optimum 4745; single-gather optimum 4814
4715 forced cells and 23 contradiction certificates force 30 more; 1400 subsets agree
490 gather pieces; 104 diagonals and 5720 odd zeros; source column 4 improves 44 to 43
```

All 10,816 affine forms and the complete schedule pass the source formula, affine evaluation and direct piece accumulation. Four rational prefix families give 416 further column checks. Controls reject a false contradiction, a lost optimum, a late gather and a wrong total; omitting a needed contradiction weakens the bound. The unchanged source replay, normal/optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44436645590/job/135267055507) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied the [signed witness and model](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5ca92afebe8ed0208c9a1ffbee0424f98a9eff6e/research/p104-c56-split-gather-witness/README.md), [compact geometry and flags](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5ca92afebe8ed0208c9a1ffbee0424f98a9eff6e/research/p104-c56-split-gather-witness/WITNESS.json) and [unchanged checker](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5ca92afebe8ed0208c9a1ffbee0424f98a9eff6e/research/p104-c56-split-gather-witness/verify.py). His source credits DreamingOfClouds (@DreamingOfClouds), with Claude Opus 5.5 assistance, for the C=56 model, chain configuration and split-gather question in [PR #7689](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7689) at `511e7d0852acdca291b50c538b978fb063ae7bac`. All six source files and notices are retained byte-exact. Ali Romman (@aliromman) supplied the exact optimization, proof and new checker with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Changed flags, split reads, other row models, native realization, storage/restoration and the complete paid caller invoice remain open. The full PR7689 global-flag and Lean suites, selected cold replay and Docker were not run. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged. No independent human/formal-kernel acceptance or global literature priority is claimed.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Source pins do not assert unmerged ancestry. Apache-2.0. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19722957).
